import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int i = 0;
        int a = 0, b = 0;
        if (n > 0) {
            do {
                int x = sc.nextInt();
                if (i == 0) {
                    a = b = x;
                } else {
                    a = Math.min(a, x);
                    b = Math.max(b, x);
                }
                i++;
            } while (i < n);
        }
        System.out.println((a + b) / 2);
        sc.close();
    }
}
